description: Registry of thesis/dissertation output-format classes for the dataimago dissertation vertical. Consumed by dissertation-ai onboarding (interview Q15), Level-3 generated-app PDF builds, and the Level-3 author harness. See docs/discovery-contract.md.

modes.shipped: A class exists in this registry for the institution; use it as-is.
modes.vendored: The author supplies their institution's class; normalize it here and optionally contribute back.
modes.generated: No class exists; the author's AI drafts one from written guidelines, validates it, and may contribute it back.

classes.lineage: John P. Weiss (1997) → maintained through v1.14; hyperref-compatible (Ni 2014); signature page removed, committee on title page (Anderson 2020)
classes.notes: Provides \title, \author, \degree, \dept, \advisor, \reader/\readerThree, \abstract, \dedication, \acknowledgements, and \ToCisShort/\LoFisShort/\LoTisShort one-page toggles. See classes/cu-boulder/README.md.
